_about: 'What you're carrying': two or three sentences above each briefing from Quarter 2 on, written once when the quarter opens so the whole team reads the same words. Draft for Vikram's review, 9 October 2026.
title: What you're carrying
rules: Write two or three sentences, at most 65 words in all, reminding a team of executives what they are bringing into the new quarter at their company: what they said they wanted Halden to become, what they have been doing, and how it has gone.
Speak to them as 'you'. Plain, calm English, like a chief of staff's note. No lists, no markdown, no headings.
Only use figures that appear below, exactly as given. Use at most two figures.
Never give advice, never suggest what to do, never name options or choices, and never hint at what is coming. Describe; don't recommend.
Never mention a course, class, simulation, game, students, grades, scores, ranks, weeks or rounds.
